Visit note | 2025-10-04 10:30 AM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Sanjay Bhattacharya, 43, male. Mr. Bhattacharya returns for review of his cramping belly pain and stools that switch between loose and hard. He is an office cleaner and notes these symptoms flare on long commutes through traffic in Rampura. He has no other medical conditions and reports taking previous advice. On examination: pain score 3/10, BP 111/80 mmHg, pulse 71 bpm, weight 54 kg. Abdomen is soft with mild lower quadrant tenderness and no masses. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.
